title: The Value of Piped Water and Sewers: Evidence from 19th Century Chicago
abstract: We estimate the impact of piped water and sewers on property values in late 19th century Chicago. The cost of sewer construction depends sensitively on imperceptible variation in elevation, and such variation delays water and sewer service to part of the city. This delay provides quasi-random variation for causal estimates. We extrapolate ate estimates from our natural experiment to the area treated with water and sewer service during 1874-1880 using a new estimator. Water and sewer access increases property values by a factor of about 2.8.This suggests that benefits are large relative to the value of averted mortality, many other infrastructure projects, and construction costs.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了19世纪后期芝加哥自来水和下水道对房产价值的影响。下水道的建设成本对高程上难以察觉的变化高度敏感，这种变化延迟了城市部分地区的供水和排水服务。这一延迟为因果估计提供了准随机变异。我们利用一种新的估计量，将自然实验的估计结果外推至1874—1880年间接受供水和下水道服务的地区。自来水和下水道的接入使房产价值提高了约2.8倍。这表明，相对于避免死亡的价值、许多其他基础设施项目以及建设成本，其收益都是巨大的。

title: Climate Disasters, Social Media, and Climate Activism
abstract: Does exposure to climate-related natural disasters affect individuals' willingness to engage in climate activism? Prior studies show that exposure to climate change affects pro-climate preferences, but there is little evidence on whether it changes individuals' participation in costly, public actions to influence climate policy. We assemble a novel panel dataset of nearly 150,000 reported attendances at more than 5,000 pro-climate events in the United States. Using a stacked event study approach, we show exposure to climate change-related natural disasters causes a sharp increase in attendance at pro-climate events which then decays over time. We also show that attendance increases in distant areas that are socially connected to disaster areas. Furthermore, public exposure to large pro-climate events itself transfers through the social network. These effects rely on the presence of an existing advocacy infrastructure. Our results suggest that increasingly salient climate risks may not only spur advocacy locally, but also generate wider demand for pro-climate policy action.
abstract_zh: 暴露于与气候相关的自然灾害，是否会影响个人参与气候行动主义的意愿？既有研究表明，暴露于气候变化会影响亲气候的偏好，但关于它是否会改变个人参与旨在影响气候政策的代价高昂的公开行动，证据很少。我们构建了一个新颖的面板数据集，包含美国5000多场亲气候活动近15万次有记录的参与情况。采用堆叠事件研究方法，我们发现暴露于与气候变化相关的自然灾害会导致亲气候活动的参与人数急剧增加，但此后随时间逐渐衰减。我们还表明，与灾区存在社会联系的遥远地区，其参与人数同样会增加。此外，公众对大型亲气候活动的接触本身也会通过社交网络传播。这些效应依赖于既有倡导基础设施的存在。我们的研究结果表明，日益突出的气候风险不仅可能在本地激发倡导行动，还可能产生更广泛的亲气候政策行动需求。

title: Extreme Temperatures, Local Economic Conditions, and Electoral Consequences
Eyes on the Floodplain: Flood Risk Disclosure, Neighborhood Change, and Crime
Waterfronts as Amenities: Evidence from the Chicago River Reversal
Climate Risk and Preferences over the Size of Government: Evidence from California Wildfires
abstract: How does exposure to risk shape individual preferences for an expanded state? I examine this question in the context of climate change-related risk. Using variation in California wildfire activity, I show neighborhoods experiencing large fires increase support by 0.8 percentage points for ballot initiatives which expand the size of government and by 2.4 percentage points for ballot initiatives endorsed by pro-environment interest groups. The effect is stronger in Republican areas and is not driven by shifts in voter registration or turnout, suggesting the mechanism acts through changes in individual preferences rather than compositional changes in the electorate.
abstract_zh: 风险暴露如何塑造个人对扩大国家规模的偏好？我以气候变化相关风险为背景考察这一问题。利用加利福尼亚州野火活动的变化，我发现经历大火的社区对扩大政府规模的公投提案的支持率提高了0.8个百分点，对由环保利益集团背书的公投提案的支持率提高了2.4个百分点。这种效应在共和党选区更为强烈，并且不是由选民登记或投票率的变化所驱动，这表明其作用机制是个人偏好的改变，而非选民构成的变化。

title: The Short-Term Effect of the Daylight Saving Time Clock Change on High School Standardized Test Performance
Wildfire Smoke and Private Provision of Public Air-Quality Monitoring
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Governments monitor air quality for regulatory purposes and, more recently, to provide information so individuals can act to lower their exposure to air pollution. Recent developments in low-cost technologies have also led to private adoption of air-quality monitors that produce publicly accessible air-quality readings. We study the adoption of these private air-quality monitors. We find that shocks to air pollution from wildfire result in substantial adoption. We also find that additional private monitors are concentrated in white, wealthy, and politically liberal neighborhoods. In contrast, there is no evidence that pollution shocks lead to higher adoption in neighborhoods with lower pre-existing access to monitors, higher long-run pollution, or those with more vulnerable populations. The resulting stark differences in the availability of localized air-quality information suggest that private provision may worsen not ameliorate inequalities in the impacts of poor air quality.
abstract_zh: 政府出于监管目的监测空气质量，并且近来也为个人提供信息，以便其采取行动降低自身的空气污染暴露。低成本技术的最新发展，也促使私人采用空气质量监测仪，并产生可供公众获取的空气质量读数。我们研究了这些私人空气质量监测仪的采用情况。我们发现，野火导致的空气污染冲击会引发大量的采用行为。我们还发现，额外的私人监测仪集中于白人、富裕和政治上较为自由的社区。与此相反，没有证据表明，在先前监测仪可及性较低、长期污染水平较高或弱势人口较多的社区中，污染冲击会导致更高的采用率。由此产生的局部空气质量信息可获得性的显著差异表明，私人供给可能会加剧而非缓解空气质量不佳所造成影响的不平等。
